verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a first-party People Batch API that creates many W-2 employees in a single asynchronous request and fires a webhook when the batch results are ready. That is a genuine bulk operation, but the evidence covers only one operation type (employee creation). The rest of the pack shows per-item endpoints, idempotency and pagination rather than bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk update, delete or other actions beyond employee creation; bulk operations across other entities (contractors, payrolls, time off); independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: People Batch API - Create batches of employees in a single request.
allowing you to submit a batch of employees and their essential information—as you might do when onboarding a company—in a single request.
